# Repute India AI

> Repute India AI is a software and AI company serving businesses across India, UAE, East Africa, UK and worldwide. It builds websites, CRMs, custom business systems, mobile apps, AI agents and WhatsApp automation for businesses, and runs "Get Found in AI Search", a monthly service that gets a business named when customers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google for a recommendation.

## Services

- Website Development
- CRM Development
- Custom Business Systems (ERP-style)
- Get Found in AI Search (AI search visibility)
- Mobile Apps (Android and iOS)
- AI Agents (multilingual, in the customer's language)
- WhatsApp Automation
- Reputation Management (Google reviews)
- Business Process Automation
- E-commerce

## Get Found in AI Search — plans (India, per month)

- Found: ₹4,999 per month, one-time setup ₹7,000. 10 buyer questions tracked, 15 profiles, 2 articles a month, monthly AI Visibility Report.
- Featured: ₹12,999 per month, one-time setup ₹12,000. 25 buyer questions tracked, 30 profiles, 4 articles a month, 1 third-party placement a month, monthly report and call.
- Authority: ₹29,999 per month, one-time setup ₹20,000. 50 buyer questions plus 3 competitors tracked, 40+ profiles, 8 articles a month, 3 third-party placements a month plus quarterly PR, fortnightly report and call.
- Minimum term is 6 months, because AI answers usually take 3 to 6 months to change.
- Local-currency pricing is also available for the UAE, the UK, Australia and the USA.
- East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda): US$59, US$119 and US$209 per month for Found, Featured and Authority. Payment by bank transfer or card, M-Pesa on request.
- No ranking is guaranteed. No fake reviews, made-up awards or unlabelled paid placements.

## Solution pages

- [WhatsApp CRM for clinics](https://reputeindiaai.com/whatsapp-crm-for-clinics/): Repute India AI builds WhatsApp-based CRMs for clinics in India, the UAE and Kenya, so every patient enquiry is captured, followed up and booked automatically.
- [Custom CRM development in Dubai](https://reputeindiaai.com/custom-crm-development-dubai/): Repute India AI builds custom CRMs for small businesses in Dubai and across the UAE, so every lead, quote and follow-up lives in one system shaped around how your team already works.
- [Website + app for real estate](https://reputeindiaai.com/real-estate-website-and-app/): Repute India AI builds websites, mobile apps and CRMs for real estate developers in India and the UAE, so enquiries, site visits, bookings and payments are tracked in one connected system.
- [AI search visibility (GEO)](https://reputeindiaai.com/ai-search-visibility-geo/): Repute India AI helps businesses in India, the UAE and the UK get named when buyers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google for a recommendation. This is called AI search visibility, or generative engine optimisation (GEO).
- [Custom CRM for small business](https://reputeindiaai.com/custom-crm-for-small-business/): Repute India AI builds custom CRMs for small businesses, so leads, follow-ups, quotes, orders and customer history sit in one system that matches the way your team already works.
- [WhatsApp automation](https://reputeindiaai.com/whatsapp-automation/): Repute India AI sets up WhatsApp automation for small businesses, so enquiries get an instant reply, follow-ups and reminders go out on time, and every conversation is saved in one place.
- [CRM for coaching institutes](https://reputeindiaai.com/crm-for-coaching-institutes/): Repute India AI builds CRMs and student apps for coaching institutes, so enquiries, admissions, fees, attendance and results are managed in one system instead of registers and spreadsheets.
- [Mobile apps for small business](https://reputeindiaai.com/app-development-for-small-business/): Repute India AI builds mobile apps for small businesses: customer apps for booking, ordering and loyalty, and staff apps for daily work, on Android and iOS and connected to your CRM.
